title: 49ers’ Brock Purdy’s ‘Obviously That’s Not Me’ Answer Lands On The AI Rap Clips
key_facts: Gridiron Heroics reports that San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy has seen AI-generated videos of himself rapping with a synthesised voice that circulate on TikTok and Instagram.
In his most recent media availability Purdy said teammates including receiver Deebo Samuel send him the videos on Instagram.
Asked his opinion, Purdy said 'I think they are funny. But yeah, obviously that's not me', which prompted laughter in the room.
The article adds that Purdy has led the 49ers to a 4-0 start, with 1,007 passing yards and 11 touchdown passes, and is an early NFL MVP candidate.
The article reports no complaint, legal step or harm linked to the videos.
quote_evidence: I think they are funny. But yeah, obviously that’s not me.
The rappers, yeah, yeah, Deebo (wide receiver Deebo Samuel) and all the guys DM them to me on Instagram.
These videos depict digitally altered versions of Purdy performing rap songs with his likeness and a synthesized voice.
why_it_matters_hint: A well-known player shrugs off AI fakes of himself with a joke, showing how common such clips of public figures have become.
event_date: Purdy's remarks came in his most recent media availability, date not stated; published 10 Oct 2026.
notes: Small sports site; Purdy's quotes come from a media session, not named reporters. The clips themselves were not seen.
